Rooms.Name: A dark path in a dense forest
Rooms.Description:
As you move further ahead, you can see light in the distance. It looks like
there's a clearing in the forest.

Exits.Description: You can see a small clearing

Rooms.Name: A small clearing in the forest
Rooms.Description:
You have stepped into a small clearing in the forest. It seems that this
part of the forest had been burnt down in the last forest fire or the like.
There is a small hole in the ground in the middle of the clearing.

Exits.Description: The hole seems barely big enough to fit a person your size.

Rooms.Name: Beneath the Earth's Crust
Rooms.Description:
You are now beneath the Earth's crust. The walls seem brittle and your fear
of it collapsing overwhelms you. The hole sinks deeper into the Earth and above
you is the life you so well know.

Exits.Description: The blue clear sky of the Earth lies above you.
The Earth below seems to be getting more and more brittle.

Rooms.Name: Beneath the Earth's Crust
Rooms.Description:
The downward climb has to come to an abrupt stop. The walls seem to have
become more compact and small torches line the walls. A narrow mine shaft leads
off in the east. There are some writings on the north wall. A hole leads back
up towards the surface.

Exits.Description: The mine shaft look relatively safe.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You have entered the Pathway to Hell
If you are below level 70, RUN!
Else feel free to DIE!

Rooms.Name: Within the Mine Shaft
Rooms.Description:
The mine shaft is narrow and you feel suffocated as you walk slowly through
it. The mine shaft fades off to the south. To the west lies the entrance to the
mine shaft.

Exits.Description: The mine shaft leads off to the south.
The entrance to the mine shaft lies to the west.

Rooms.Name: Within the Mine Shaft
Rooms.Description:
The mine shaft seems to come to a complete stop. A ladder leads downward to
another mine shaft.

Exits.Description: The mine shaft leads off to the north.
The mine shaft is bearly visible.

Rooms.Name: Within the Mine Shaft
Rooms.Description:
The mine shaft is barely visible and you are forced to use your light. Bones
are scattered about the floor and you shiver at the meaning of this. The mine
shaft leads off to the east.

Exits.Description: The mine shaft leads off to the east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like the remains of a poor adventurer who ventured too far.

Rooms.Name: Within the Mine Shaft
Rooms.Description:
The mine shaft begins to cringe inwards as if to try and grab you. The
torches are now non-existent and a smell leads you down the mine shaft eastward.

Exits.Description: The mine shaft leads off to the east.
The mine shaft leads off to the west.

Rooms.Name: Within the Mine Shaft
Rooms.Description:
The mine shaft comes again to a sharp end. A small ladder leads you downward
once again. You fear at the thought of what lies beneath you. The room itself
seems to be getting warmer as you travel farther along the mine shaft.

Exits.Description: The mine shaft leads off to the west.
A ladder leads you to what is below.

Rooms.Name: A Small Narrow Room
Rooms.Description:
You have come down into a small room. The heat here is intense. A huge
portal with strange symbols is to the north. It seems to radiate heat from
itself.

Exits.Description: Blue and White light is flashing forwards and backwards.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The symbols tell the story of immense suffering.

Arcane symbols cover the gate.
It looks like some magical gate to another plane.

Rooms.Name: The Entryway to Hell
Rooms.Description:
You step into the portal and with a flash of light you find yourself
transferred to Hell. You are standing here at the entryway to hell. The scenery
here consists entirely of flames and souls. The air reeks of brimstone and the
air is filled with the screams of the tortured souls of the mud addicts.
However, as unpleasant as this seems, you realize that you must still be
living, and therefore somewhat immune to the flames that light the place.

Exits.Description: You see the Room of Satanics.
You see a room bathed in fire.

Rooms.Name: Hot Fiery Room
Rooms.Description:
The heat from this room, either caused by your imagination or real, is
stifling and you find it harder to breathe.

Exits.Description: You see the Entryway to Hell.

Rooms.Name: The Eternal Fire of Damnation
Rooms.Description:
As you enter here, you realize that this is the source of the flames, and
that you are not as immune to the flames as you thought...

Rooms.Name: The Room of Satanics
Rooms.Description:
In this room lies the tortured souls of those that betrayed IO and worshipped
Satan and his minions.

Exits.Description: You see the Room of Blind Followers.
You see the Entryway to Hell.

Rooms.Name: The Room of Blind Followers
Rooms.Description:
This is the room where those the blindly followed the false prophets of
society and in their misery blind those around them.

Exits.Description: You see the Room of Satanics.

Rooms.Name: The Room of Counselors
Rooms.Description:
This is the room of counselors which preach for Satan. An immense heat is
emanating from the fires which are burning all over this place. To the south
you can see a black building.

Rooms.Name: The Satanic Temple
Rooms.Description:
As you enter the building all heat from the outside dies away. The room has
a huge altar at its end. Two huge statues of Satan stands on both side of the
altar.

Exits.Description: You see the Room of Counselors.
You see the Room of Worship.
You see the Room of Satanics.

Rooms.Name: The Room of Worship
Rooms.Description:
In this room are loyal worshippers holding services to IO, praying for their
salvation. They will find none though as they are all to far gone. On the altar
you see the human sacrifices with which they had hoped to draw IO's attention.
As it has failed, they are now looking for another live soul to sacrifice...

Rooms.Name: The Waiting Room
Rooms.Description:
Along the walls of fire you see benches of bones and seats of souls. This is
where those whose souls have been sold waiting for their mortal shell to return
to dust.

Exits.Description: You see the Room of Souls.
You see the Room of Counselors.

Rooms.Name: Room of Souls
Rooms.Description:
Inside this room are the souls of all those who are not mud-addicts, and
thereby are surely unbelievers...

Rooms.Name: Room of the Guardian
Rooms.Description:
In this room you see the Guardian of the Night, Keeper of the Nightmares of
Man. It is dressed in the heaviest robes of black, and all that you can see are
the reds of their eyes. And they come for you...

Rooms.Name: Judgment Room
Rooms.Description:
This is the room where the souls are to be judged for good or for ill, for
IO or for Satan. You shudder as your thoughts drift towards your past...

Exits.Description: You see the Room of the Executioner.

Rooms.Name: Room of the Executioner
Rooms.Description: In here lie the bones of the Executioner, being stitched together once more.

Exits.Description: You see the illusion of safety.

Rooms.Name: Room of Illusions
Rooms.Description:
You suddenly feel so very evil (hehe). Your companions start to look towards
you menacingly with evil in their eyes. Suddenly, just as you are going to
attack each other, you realize that it was merely an illusion...

Exits.Description: You see the Room of the Executioner.
You see the Room of the Dead.

Rooms.Name: Room of Dead Gods
Rooms.Description:
In this room you see the bones of many people. You consider recalling, as
the fear of your mortality suddenly rocks your soul.

Exits.Description: You see the illusion of safety.

Rooms.Name: Pit of Satan
Rooms.Description:
You have done it now. You are at the very most depths of hell itself. Before
you stands the altar of none other than the master of evil himself, The Lord of
Death, Satan.

Exits.Description: You see the Room of the Dead.

Rooms.Name: Bottomless Pit
Rooms.Description:
You descend deeper and deeper into the depths of hell. The flames are
getting hotter, and still you see no end to the pit.

Rooms.Name: Bottomless Pit
Rooms.Description:
After descending deeper and deeper into the depths of hell, you wonder if
you will ever reach the bottom. The intensity of the heat is unimaginable.

Exits.Description: You see flames erupting from the rooms ahead.

Rooms.Name: Bottomless Pit
Rooms.Description:
You descend deeper and deeper into the depths of hell. The flames are
getting hotter, and still you see no end to the pit.

Exits.Description: You see the Room of the Guardian.
You see the Room of Judgment.
You cannot see through the flames above.

Rooms.Name: In the Heat of Hell
Rooms.Description:
The heat from the room seems to scold you as you try to walk through it,
carefully avoiding the largest flames.

Rooms.Name: In the Heat of Hell
Rooms.Description:
The heat from the room seems to scold you as you try to walk through it,
carefully avoiding the largest flames. Hell extends to the north, east and
west.

Rooms.Name: In the Heat of Hell
Rooms.Description:
The flames seem to be getting larger as you go deeper into hell. The heat
seems to intensify to the south. Hell extends southward and eastward.

Rooms.Name: In the Flames of Hell
Rooms.Description:
The flames seem to get significantly larger. Your movement seems to be more
and more hesitant of the dangers ahead. The flames seem to spew forth from the
east.

Rooms.Name: In the Flames of Hell
Rooms.Description:
The flames seem to get significantly larger. Your movement seems to be more
and more hesitant of the dangers ahead. The flames seem to spew forth from the
south.

Rooms.Name: Near a Large Flame
Rooms.Description:
You enter a room and are stopped by your natural instincts. You feel a sense
of danger to the west. The flames seem to only come from the north and the
light seems to be non-existent to the west.

Exits.Description: Darkness seems to prevail in this direction.

Rooms.Name: The Throne of Queen Ferrix
Rooms.Description:
Here lies the evil Queen Ferrix upon her thrown. All light seems to be
absorbed into her. She gleams an evil grin at you and watches your every
movement.

Rooms.Name: In the Heat of Hell
Rooms.Description:
The flames seem to get larger and hotter as you travel further into hell. It
seems to extend towards the west and south.

Rooms.Name: In the Heat of Hell
Rooms.Description:
The flames seem to get larger and hotter as you travel further into hell. It
seems to extend to the north, south and east.

Rooms.Name: The Imprisonment Room
Rooms.Description:
Here lies the many good souls captured by Satan. The sufferers lie chained
hopelessly to the walls awaiting true death and release from the tortures of
hell.

Rooms.Name: In the Heat of Hell
Rooms.Description:
The flames seem to get larger and hotter as you travel deeper into hell. The
flames spew forth from the east and west.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to the Pit
Rooms.Description:
Here is an entrance to a pit leading downwards. Heat seems to radiate from
it hotter than you have ever known before. The flames of hell also continue
back towards the west.

Rooms.Name: The Bottomless Pit
Rooms.Description:
You descend deeper and deeper into the depths of hell. The flames seem to be
getting hotter and hotter.

Rooms.Name: Deep within the Flames of Hell
Rooms.Description:
The heat here is intense, but you sense that this may be the worst of it.
The flames extend in all four directions.

Rooms.Name: Home of the Furies
Rooms.Description:
Here lie the three furies of the great Uranus. They seem to flutter towards
you and attack instantly. The heat of hell lies to the north.

Rooms.Name: Deep within the Flames of Hell
Rooms.Description:
The heat here is intense, but you sense that this may be the worst of it.
The flames extend out to the west and south.

Rooms.Name: Deep within the Flames of Hell
Rooms.Description:
The heat here is intense, but you sense that this may be the worst of it.
The flames extend to the east and west.

Rooms.Name: Deep within the Flames of Hell
Rooms.Description:
The heat here is intense, but you sense that this may be the worst of it.
The flames extend to the east and south.

Rooms.Name: The Boundaries of Flames
Rooms.Description:
The flames of hell seem to have come to a stop. To the west lies a deep dark
gloomy area. Your own keen sense is wary about travel in this direction.

Exits.Description: The dark protrudes in this direction.

Rooms.Name: Deep within the Underworld
Rooms.Description:
You have traveled deeper into the underworld. Here, the flames of hell are
non-existent. But more so, the cold eerie death is all that you feel.

Exits.Description: The flames of hell lies here.
The Underworld extends out in this direction.

Rooms.Name: Deep within the Flames of Hell
Rooms.Description:
The heat here is intense, but you sense that this may be the worst of it.
The flames extend in all four directions.

Rooms.Name: Before the Spawning Room
Rooms.Description:
The room is intense with heat. To the west, you see flames spew up and
around like frenzied pigs. To the north, the flames of hell continue to fill
your body with heat.

Exits.Description: Flames flicker back and forth to the west.

Rooms.Name: Spawning Room
Rooms.Description:
The room is hot with red flames. Hell Spawns seem to float around you
waiting for the right moment to make their moves upon you. The Hell Spawns vary
in size from large to small.

Rooms.Name: Deep within the Underworld
Rooms.Description:
Here, the flames of hell no longer burn bright. Instead, the deathless
silence of the true Underworld has taken over and makes you shiver and the very
thoughts of what lies ahead. The passageway back towards the flames thins into
nothingness.

Exits.Description: The Underworld continues in this direction.

Rooms.Name: Deep within the Underworld
Rooms.Description:
The Underworld is a cold place. Death seems to be all that you can think
about. Hundreds of images of death enter your mind.

Exits.Description: The Underworld continues in this direction.
The Underworld continues in this direction.

Rooms.Name: Before Fate
Rooms.Description:
You stop for an instant thinking of all the memories of your life. They seem
to flash before you as if death was knocking upon your front door.

Exits.Description: The Underworld continues in this direction.

Rooms.Name: Room of Fate
Rooms.Description:
You enter a small room. There seems to be nothing but the cold walls here.
Then suddenly, you realize all that is around you. A HUGE black door can be
seen to the west. Could this be your fate? Is death a certain reality?

Rooms.Name: The Throne of Hades
Rooms.Description:
You feel good to be alive, but the sight of the mighty Hades peering over
you sends chills through your mind. You are overcome with a feeling of
uselessness. Your magic powers feel weak and you are drained of the mystical
enchantments that seemed to have protected you so well before.

Rooms.Name: Bottomless Pit
Rooms.Description:
After descending deeper and deeper into the depths of hell, you wonder if
you will ever reach the bottom. The intensity of the heat is unimaginable.

Mobs.Name: death demon
Mobs.LongDescription: A death demon is here looking for prey.
Mobs.Description: The demon seems to be ready to jump on the first sight of living flesh he sees.

Mobs.Name: crazed man worshipper
Mobs.LongDescription: A crazed worshipper is standing here screaming.
Mobs.Description:
The worshipper has eyes of red and look as though Satan has stolen his soul for
keeps.

Mobs.Name: minor demon
Mobs.LongDescription: A minor demon is searching for a soul to torture.
Mobs.Description:
The demon has a cruel gleam in his eyes, and starts looking at your soul. He is
clothed in fire and carries a wicked looking scythe.

Mobs.Name: walking satanic
Mobs.LongDescription: The walking satanic is searching for worthy souls.

Mobs.Name: blind follower
Mobs.LongDescription: A blind follower is practicing a spell.

Mobs.Name: satanic
Mobs.LongDescription: A satanic is searching for a good soul.
Mobs.Description: The satanic wants you to follow him.

Mobs.Name: jack ripper
Mobs.LongDescription: Jack the Ripper is looking for live bait.
Mobs.Description: Jack is cleaning the blood off his knife.

Mobs.Name: hell hound
Mobs.LongDescription: A hell hound is here mucking on the souls of the dead.
Mobs.Description: This undead creature is a horrible abomination of a beastly fido.

Mobs.Name: worshipper
Mobs.LongDescription: A worshipper prostrates himself in the name of Satan.
Mobs.Description: What a pitiful excuse for a worshipper.

Mobs.Name: warlock
Mobs.LongDescription: A warlock will pray for you in the name of Satan.
Mobs.Description: The warlock has an aura of the deepest shade of blood.

Mobs.Name: counsellor
Mobs.LongDescription: A counsellor tries to lure you deeper into hell.
Mobs.Description: The counsellor radiates an aura of evil.

Mobs.Name: concubine
Mobs.LongDescription: A concubine is here trying to make your life a living hell.
Mobs.Description: Nag Nag Nag...

Mobs.Name: mud addict soul
Mobs.LongDescription: One of numerous souls of a mud addict wails here.
Mobs.Description: The soul stares at you mournfully, shaking it's head.

Mobs.Name: guardian
Mobs.LongDescription: The Guardian of the Night will not let you live.
Mobs.Description: Looks like the biggest, baddest, and ugliest thing you have ever seen.

Mobs.Name: satan
Mobs.LongDescription: Satan is coming to collect your soul.
Mobs.Description: Satan is the Master of Evil.

Mobs.Name: major demon
Mobs.LongDescription: A major demon is painting the walls with your blood.
Mobs.Description: The major demon has got to be the second ugliest thing you have ever seen.

Mobs.Name: bael baelzubel
Mobs.LongDescription: Baelzubel is spreading lies and deception.
Mobs.Description: Baelzubel is the Lord of the Lies.

Mobs.Name: sufferer
Mobs.LongDescription: A sufferer looks at you for sympathy.
Mobs.Description: A sufferer is here wailing in pain and agony.

Mobs.Name: greater demon huge
Mobs.LongDescription: A greater demon claws at you angrily.
Mobs.Description:
A huge demon looks evil and angry at your presence. Its teeth dripping 
with blood from its last victim.

Mobs.Name: fury
Mobs.LongDescription: A Fury flies towards you in attempt to consume you.
Mobs.Description:
The Fury flutters around you looking for spots to feed upon. It's body is
covered in the blood of past warriors.

Mobs.Name: hades
Mobs.LongDescription: Hades laughs at your mortality and lunges towards you.
Mobs.Description: Hades appears as a reincarnation of death as known to you.

Mobs.Name: hell spawn
Mobs.LongDescription: A hell spawn attempts to kill you!
Mobs.Description:
Their eyes are bright red with blood as its true meaning. It looks hungry
for the blood of any prey it can get.

Mobs.Name: ferrix queen
Mobs.LongDescription: Queen Ferrix is waiting here in search for mortal men.
Mobs.Description:
Here lies a beutiful woman whom at first glance, appears peaceful and loving.
But as you peer close, you can see the death claws of her nails and the
vicous armor worn by her.

Mobs.Name: liz borden
Mobs.LongDescription: Liz Borden is looking for live bait.
Mobs.Description: Liz is cleaning the blood off her knife.

Objects.Name: evil jack jack's knife
Objects.Description: The evil knife of Jack the Ripper lies here, dripping with blood.

Objects.Name: pitch fork satan satan's
Objects.Description: Satan's pitch fork sings "My heart bleeds for you..."

Objects.Name: hell hellfire whip
Objects.Description: A whip is ablaze with the fires of hell.

Objects.Name: lost ring soul souls
Objects.Description: A ring vibrates as if it has a life of its own.

Objects.Name: potion red vial
Objects.Description: A small vial of red liquid is sitting here. It seems to have a label.

Objects.Name: potion white vial
Objects.Description: A small vial of white liquid is sitting here. It seems to have a label.

Objects.Name: potion black vial
Objects.Description: A small vial of black liquid is sitting here. It seems to have a label.

Objects.Name: red scythe death
Objects.Description: A scythe burns with the fires of Hell.

Objects.Name: fountain blood youth
Objects.Description: You see the fabled Fountain of Youth.

Objects.Name: shimmering war band
Objects.Description: Here lies a shimmering band with symbols of war written upon it.

Objects.Name: ferrix diamond armor
Objects.Description: A suit of armor made of diamond lies here.

Objects.Name: hades death suit
Objects.Description: A suit that emulates death lies here.

Objects.Name: aura light stick
Objects.Description: A small stick lies here emulating light all around.

Objects.Name: potion grey vial
Objects.Description: a small vial of grey liquid is sitting here. It seems to have a label.

Objects.Name: emerald bracer
Objects.Description: A small bracer made of emerald lies here.

Objects.Name: crimson long sword
Objects.Description: A long sword made of crimson lies here.

Objects.Name: staff hellstaff
Objects.Description: You see a staff with strange carvings lying here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you look closer at the staff you can see strange carvings:
"Irt Thidi Gravasiity Focsitl"

Objects.Name: evil liz borden axe
Objects.Description: The evil axe of Liz Borden lies here, dripping with blood.

Objects.Name: suit fire
Objects.Description: An unbearably hot suit is burning here.

Objects.Name: amulet true armor
Objects.Description: A small amulet with a silver shield etched upon it lies here.
